title: February 2026 White Sands event and El Paso airspace closure
place_text: White Sands, New Mexico; El Paso, Texas

tellings.quote: what happened at White Sands in February of 2026?

plain: Something is said to have happened at White Sands, the military test range in New Mexico, in February 2026, around the time the airspace over El Paso, Texas, was closed. Michels raises it as a question to his guest Matthew Brown, a Pentagon whistleblower, asking "what happened at White Sands in February of 2026?" The telling gives no details of the event itself, only that Michels thinks it is worth asking about.
